body:
Here's a contrived example I came up with (tested in chrome and firefox):
From a page loaded as a file URL, window.open an https page, then navigate the first window to the same origin, then the second window will be able to access its opener.

If we were to always force a swap here, then that opener access wouldn't work. As for whether that's desirable or not, I don't know.
